newsitem.title: GERMANY: Porsche shares buck trend, turn higher.
newsitem.headline: Porsche shares buck trend, turn higher.

text.p: Shares in Porsche AG surged in dealings on Thursday after the German sports car maker said its profit for the 1995/96 year would be 40 to 50 million marks and above earlier expectations.
Porsche also said it would consider in November resuming a dividend payout on its preference shares for the first time since the 1991/92 business year.
Preference shares of Porsche were up 45 marks at 1,110 marks in post-bourse IBIS electronic dealings. The shares ended bourse trade up eight marks at 1,083 marks.
Porsche's gains bucked the overall market trend, particularly among carmaker shares, as the 30-share DAX index ended bourse trade down 22.24 points at 2,680.75.
Among carmakers, Volkswagen AG was down nine marks at 572.25 marks, Daimler-Benz AG was down 1.21 marks at 82.85 marks and BMW AG was down seven marks at 877 marks.
